slides.title: A district almost emptied of its people
slides.body: Merti woreda, Arsi Zone. Borkena, Nov 9, 2026

slides.title: kebeles fully displaced in Merti
slides.body: Community representatives told Borkena only two kebeles still have residents. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Displaced for up to three years
slides.body: Some families have lived in temporary displacement for years. Others fled attacks in late October.

slides.title: Flight across four woredas
slides.body: Borkena reports people fleeing repeated attacks by armed groups in Merti, Shirka, Aseko and Robe. No group was named.

slides.title: Short of food, clothing and care
slides.body: Families rely on makeshift shelters, informal rentals or host families. Many say they have received no direct relief.

slides.title: Aid 'severely insufficient'
slides.body: Merti's administrator said daily relief continues but falls far short, and asked aid agencies to help.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Get aid to the displaced.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
